title: Try a tool, keep the evidence
summary: A starter research page you can edit yourself. Use these entries as a checklist for evaluating a connection. They are examples, not completed test results; the **Tool shortlist** tab keeps the broader reference list.

items.title: Try a Blender connection
items.body: Read the provider's setup instructions, then try one small scene operation. Record the tool version and what happened before adding it to a production workflow.

items.title: Check what the tool can change
items.body: Start in a disposable project. Identify which operations read data, which write files, and which send data to another service. Record any approval steps you want the agent to keep.

items.title: Save a test you can repeat
items.body: Keep the input, the expected result and a screenshot of the actual result. If the tool changes later, rerun this same test before replacing a working setup.
items.prompt: In this disposable test project, inspect the current scene and describe one small reversible change. Wait for my review before applying it, then report the result and any errors.
